views.concern: Seat booking components, responsibilities, interactions and change impact
concern_details: What are the main components involved in the seat booking functionality?
What is each of these components responsible for?
How do these components interact with each other?
Which parts of the system may be affected by modifying the seat booking functionality?
views.reason: The stakeholder answered "not sure" to every aspect, so the choice rests on the wording of the concerns. They ask which components are involved, what each is responsible for, and how they interact. A component diagram answers all of these. It shows the parts, the interfaces each offers and needs, and the connections between them. The connections also show which neighbouring parts depend on the booking component, which answers the impact question. One view therefore covers all four concerns. The concerns ask about the interactions between components in general. They do not ask for the ordered steps of one scenario, so a sequence diagram is not needed.

also.reason: The developer will change code, and "components" could mean code modules as well as running parts. A package diagram would show how the code is divided and which modules depend on the booking module. That answers the responsibility, interaction and impact concerns equally well from the code-structure side, so the stakeholder should see both.
